svg.title: Production VLM stack
svg.desc: A native-resolution ViT with 2D-RoPE and window attention, a merger/projector that often merges 2 by 2 patches, an LLM decoder with M-RoPE, and text output including coordinates and JSON.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Production VLM: tower → merger → LLM → structured text
